title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct magnitude of the average force exerted on the brick.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the principle of conservation of energy in the reaction.

title: Momentum Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the change in momentum due to the reaction accurately.

title: Direction of Force
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the direction of the force exerted on the brick.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in momentum calculations.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify any approximations made during calculations.
